text.body: ॥ śrīvidyāraṇyāṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram ॥ vidyāraṇyamahāyogī mahāvidyāprakāśakaḥ । śrīvidyānagaroddhartā vidyāratnamahodadhiḥ ॥ 1 rāmāyaṇamahāsapta koṭimantraprakāśakaḥ । śrīdevīkaruṇāpūrṇaḥ paripūrṇamanorathaḥ ॥ 2 virūpākṣamahākṣetra svarṇavṛṣṭiprakalpakaḥ । vedatrayollasadbhāṣyakartā tatvārthakovidaḥ ॥ 3 bhagavatpādanirṇīta siddhāntasthāpanaprabhuḥ । varṇāśramavyavasthātā nigamāgamasāravit ॥ 4 śrīmatkarṇāṭarājyaśrī sampatsiṃhāsanapradaḥ । śrīmadbukkamahīpālarājyapaṭṭābhiṣekakṛt ॥ 5 ācāryakṛtabhāṣyādi granthavṛttiprakalpakaḥ । sakalopaniṣadbhāṣyadīpikādiprakāśakṛt ॥ 6 sarvaśāstrārthatatvajño mantraśāstrābdhimandaraḥ । vidvanmaṇi śiraśślādhya bahugrantha vidhāyakaḥ ॥ 7 sārasvatasamuddhartā sārāsāravicakṣaṇaḥ । śrautasmārtasadācāra saṃsthāpanadhurandharaḥ ॥ 8 vedaśāstra bahirbhūta durmatāmbhodhiśoṣakaḥ । durvādigarvadāvāgniḥ pratipakṣebhakesarī ॥ 9 yaśo jaivātṛkajyotsnā prakāśitadigantaraḥ । aṣṭāṅgayoganiṣṇātassāṅkhyogaviśāradaḥ ॥ 10 rājādhirājasandoha pūjyamānapadāmbujaḥ । mahāvaibhavasampanna audāryaśrīnivāsabhūḥ ॥ 11 tiryagāndolikāmukhya samastabirudāñcitaḥ । mahābhogī mahāyogī vairāgyaprathamāśrayaḥ ॥ 12 śrīmānparamahaṃsādisadguruḥ karuṇānidhiḥ । tapaḥprabhāvanirdhūtadurvārakalivaibhavaḥ ॥ 13 nirantaraśivadhyāna śoṣitākhilakalmaṣaḥ । nirjitārātiṣaḍvargo dāridryonmūlanakṣamaḥ ॥ 14 jitendriyassatyavādī satyasandho dṛḍhavrataḥ । śāntāsmā sucaritrāḍhya sarvabhūtahitotsukaḥ ॥ 15 kṛtakṛtyo dharmaśīlo dānto lobhavivarjitaḥ । mahābuddhirmahāvīryo mahātejā mahāmanāḥ ॥ 16 taporāśirjñānarāśiḥ kalyāṇaguṇavāridhiḥ । nītiśāstrasamuddhartā prājñamauliśiromaṇiḥ ॥ 17 śuddhasatvamayo dhīro deśakālavibhāgavit । atīndriyajñānanidhirbhūtabhāvyarthakovidaḥ ॥ 18 guṇatrayavibhāgajñassanyāsāśramadīkṣitaḥ । jñānātmakaikadaṇḍāḍhyaḥ kausumbhavasanojjavalaḥ ॥ 19 rudrākṣamālikādhārī bhasmoddhūlitadehavān । hastamālālasaddhasta stripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakaḥ ॥ 20 dharāsuratapassampatphalaṃ śubhamahodayaḥ । candramaulīśvara śrīmatpādapadmārcanotsukaḥ ॥ 21 śrīmacchaṅkarayogīndracaraṇāsaktamānasaḥ । ratnagarbhagaṇeśāna prapūjanaparāyaṇaḥ ॥ 22 śāradāmbādivyapīṭha saparyātatparāśayaḥ । avyājakaruṇāmūrtiḥ prajñānirjitagīṣpatiḥ ॥ 23 sujñāna satkṛtajagallokānandavidhāyakaḥ । pāṇīvilāsabhavanaṃ brahmānandaikalolupaḥ ॥ 24 nirmamo nirahaṅkāro nirālasyo nirākulaḥ । niścinto nityasantuṣṭo niyatātmā nirāmayaḥ ॥ 25 gurubhūmaṇḍalācāryo gurupīṭhapratiṣṭhitaḥ । sarvatantrasvatantraśca yantramantravicakṣaṇaḥ ॥ 26 śiṣṭeṣṭaphaladātā ca duṣṭanigrahadīkṣitaḥ । pratijñātārthanirvoḍhā niprahānugrahaprabhuḥ ॥ 27 jagatpūjyassadānandassākṣācchaṅkararūpabhṛta । mahālakṣmī mahāmantra puraścaryāparāyaṇaḥ ॥ 28 vidyāraṇyamahāyogi nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatam । yaḥpaṭhetsatataṃ sampatsārasvatanidhirbhavet ॥ 29 ॥ iti śrīvidyāraṇyāṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram ॥
